dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Well then. What can I do for you, youngster?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We found the evidence.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Evidence? What evidence? I don't understand what you mean.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Evidence about the strange incidents in the village. Please stop pretending.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Nonsense! What kind of strange incidents could possibly happen in our village? Well, alright then, show me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #(Hey {NICKNAME}, start with what was found near the well. Paimon's leaving it to you!)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This was found at the dry well in your backyard.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: A bag for carrying Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: This...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: ...This belongs to our family. There is nothing suspicious about it. That's right, it's very normal!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's so suspicious! Something's definitely off!

choices.text: Now then, please draw the marking that was on it.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Fine. This is indeed not my coin pouch.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: So many people have passed by my backyard, it's pretty normal for someone to have dropped it, right?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: It's...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's going on?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: *sigh* Aye, you've seen through me, alright. Now, I was really tempted to take the coin pouch for myself, you know?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Oh Densuke, how could an old man like you have such mischievous thoughts!

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: I—I already admitted my desire to steal the Mora. What else could be the problem?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Come now, I will surrender this coin pouch to the Shogunate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Something doesn't feel right here...

choices.text: Someone discarded this coin pouch intentionally.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Wh—What proof do you have for saying this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The coin pouch is just one part of the mystery. We also found...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #...Found what? Hmm, your turn now, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #({NICKNAME}, what did we find in the gully earlier... ?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This was intentionally left behind on a rainy night...

choices.text: You must be overthinking things, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #(That can't be right! {NICKNAME}, was Grandpa Densuke really just after the Mora?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (He must be hiding something else, right?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Someone discarded this coin pouch intentionally.

choices.text: Please tell me how much Mora there was inside.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Hahaha, what kind of question is that?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: There's no way you would know how much Mora was in there without opening it up either, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Now then, please draw the marking that was on it.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: This is... ahem, where did you get this?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: How can you prove that these two items are related?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, they're related alright.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Ridiculous! How can that be?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Unless... there's some kind of secret code on the Mora?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's nothing on the Mora, but we did find something elsewhere.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We found this near the remains of a cart...

choices.text: We found it on the tree branches at the entrance to the village.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: How could that be... You'll get nowhere, testing me like that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This was found at the dry well in your backyard.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: This is... This is...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: I can't believe that I was so careless when I was damaging the cart...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey now, you finally admitted it!

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Since you have already gotten this far in your investigation, there's nothing for it. I can't hide it anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: In that case, you should have a pretty good idea of what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A very good idea indeed! Grandpa Densuke, you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tried to rob a Shogunate cart, didn't you? And in the midst of the struggle, you destroyed the cart with a single punch, causing the goods to go flying into the gully.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hoping to save themselves, the Shogunate's people threw their coin pouches into the well to distract you! And then, you locked the well up to prevent others from stealing the Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that right?

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Ah? No, that's not what happened at all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Paimon was gonna ask for your key and to have that Mora at the bottom of the well...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Surrendered to the Shogunate! That's right! They were definitely going to be surrendered to the Shogunate!

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, this is what actually happened...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: There was originally a group of young people in the village who got too bold after getting drunk, and actually robbed one of the Shogunate's cargo carts. These goods and the bag both belong to the Shogunate.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: I couldn't let others know that this shameful incident occurred in our village. That's why I tried to cover it up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about your confession regarding the coin pouch...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He did that to cover up the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: That's right. I thought that you would stop the investigation once I confessed.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: If it was just me... As long as no one else was affected...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Please don't report this to the Shogunate. This isn't about me saving face. I just don't want the entire village to be dragged down in the process.

choices.text: I'm not interested in reporting you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's not why we came here!

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Oh, thank goodness! Thank goodness...

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: My conscience kept bothering me because of this cover-up, so I recorded everything in a diary.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: I threw the diary onto the roof. If you really want to read it, help yourself, but please don't ruin my recently renovated roof.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: About the lock on the well...

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Yes, it was me who locked the well up. I also wrote down where I hid the key. Go read for yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Grandpa Densuke, do you know anything about the Konda Village barrier?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Barrier? Oh, so people still know about that old legend...

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: They say that in ancient times, underneath the ground we are standing on right now, lay the roots of the Thunder Sakura. Indeed, this was one of the five roots that protect the peace on Narukami Island.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: And guarding it and its barrier was said to be a responsibility assigned to us, the Konda Clan, by the Kitsune Saiguu herself.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: But this was a long, long time ago. I hardly recall anything about the details.

choices.text: I just want to know the truth...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we didn't come here to report you!

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: The truth? Hehe... You young people these days are so interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: What is this? I can't read it.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Don't you try to fool me with some random things, youngster!
